The '''GX1 short hauler''', also called the '''short hauler''' or '''Lantillian deluxe short hauler''', was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] model produced by [[Lantillian ShipWrights/Legends|Lantillian ShipWrights]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:GX1schematics-SS.png|thumb|left|180px|GX1 schematics.]]
The GX1 was a rugged and well-engineered vessel. Originally designed as a pleasure craft, it featured several amenities geared towards the comfort of its owner, such as a well-designed galley, a [[Holotheater/Legends|holotheater]], and large living quarters. For defense, the basic configuration was armed with a civilian-graded [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser cannon]] and some modest shielding. These defenses however, often proved inadequate against attacks from [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and other attackers, so most owners quickly upgraded them.

The GX1 was easily converted from pleasure craft to cargo hauler, by removing most "pleasure" amenities. Its solid construction and reliability made it a good choice for cargo transport, and many [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|captains]] retrofitted them to serve as smuggling vessels.

One of its most infamous flaws was that its landing gear was extremely complex and maintenance-heavy. Obstructions such as dust and corrosion could easily jam its mechanisms and prevent it from retracting or deploying properly.

==History==
The GX1 original marketing targets were affluent retirees interested in cruising the starlanes in a well-equipped and comfortable vessel without the high price tags of other larger [[Yacht/Legends|star yachts]].

The [[Lantillies/Legends|Lantillies]]-based design team of engineers led by Project Engineer [[Shil Tervo/Legends|Shil Tervo]] intended to produce a model that would compete with the more popular designs from the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] that were in high demand during that time. They did not succeed in that respect, but unintentionally managed to create one of the first luxury pleasure craft that was within the average consumer's financial reach.

[[File:Gx1shorthauler.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A GX1 undergoes a refit.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the corporation had to recall all GX1s with serial prefixes TRE-0034 through TRE-5215 due to faulty electronics. Shil Tervo released an apologetic statement and revealed that thousands of GX1s had left the assembly line with malfunctioning [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] [[7Y4 sensor suite]]s, although Fabritech officials claimed that it was Lantillian's mishandling that resulted in the hardware problems. To alleviate this issue, Lantillian allowed owners to bring their starships to any [[Lantillian Spacers' Brotherhood/Legends|Lantillian Spacers' Brotherhood]] guild office to get their electronics upgraded free of charge.<ref name="HNN 46">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|business/1337_3.html|Lantillian Recalls GX1 Short Hauler}}</ref>

===Notable starships===
The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] Captain [[Ixsthmus]] flew a modified GX1 called ''[[Long Shot]]'' for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="longshot">''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]'', re-edited as ''[[Classic Campaigns]]''</ref> Another notable modified GX1 was the ''[[Nova Whisper]]'', a ship that had over the years accumulated a long list of owners.<ref name="SS" />

[[File:TheLongShot.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The ''[[Long Shot]]''.]]

A group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] discovered the ''[[Desolate]]'' on [[Otherspace]] while flying a short hauler.
